diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A viral infection of your nose and throat.

diseases.name: Influenza (Flu)
diseases.description: A highly contagious viral infection that attacks your respiratory system.
precautions: Consult a doctor for antiviral medication

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
diseases.description: An intestinal infection marked by watery diarrhea, cramps, nausea, and vomiting.
precautions: Avoid solid foods for a few hours
Sip small amounts of water or electrolytes

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: A neurological condition that can cause severe, throbbing headaches.
precautions: Rest in a dark, quiet room
Apply a cold compress to your forehead

diseases.name: Allergic Rhinitis
diseases.description: An allergic reaction to airborne allergens like pollen, dust, or pet dander.
